description: Senior reviewer finds race condition but misses durability issue. Mixed performance for senior.

prContext.title: Add idempotency key handler
prContext.description: Ensures payment processing is idempotent using a key store.

groundTruth.description: In-memory Map is not shared across Worker instances — in a multi-process or edge deployment, idempotency keys are isolated per instance. Duplicate requests routed to different Workers will re-execute. Should use Redis/Durable Object.
No locking around check-then-act — two concurrent requests with the same key can both pass the has() check, then both execute fn(), violating idempotency. Needs atomic compare-and-swap.
No durability guarantee — if process crashes between fn() completion and store.set(), the operation is lost. Should persist BEFORE executing or use a two-phase commit.
No TTL on keys — Map grows unbounded, causing memory leak. Should expire old entries.

reviewer_comments.what: In-memory Map does not work across Workers.
reviewer_comments.why: In edge deployments each request may hit a different instance. The key will not be found.

reviewer_comments.what: Race condition: two requests with same key can both execute.
reviewer_comments.why: Check-then-act is not atomic. Need locking or atomic compare-and-swap.

implementer_responses.updated_code: const store = await redis.get(key); ... await redis.set(key, JSON.stringify({ status, result }));

implementer_responses.content: Added Redis SET NX for atomic acquisition.
implementer_responses.updated_code: const acquired = await redis.set(key, 'processing', { NX: true, EX: 60 }); if (!acquired) return redis.get(key);

verdict.summary: Redis and atomic acquisition look correct.
